svg.font-family: Nunito, Inter, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Three ways to get a filled-in form back
svg.desc: Three rows. Hand-written (ask, validate, retry): 10 of 10 valid on the first try and 23 of 30 claims found. LangChain json_schema (schema sent to Ollama as format): 10 of 10 valid and 20 of 30 found. LangChain function_calling (schema offered as a tool): 6 of 10 valid and 8 of 30 found, because in 4 papers the model wrote plain text and LangChain returned None without an error.

g.text: Three ways to get a filled-in form back
Same ten abstracts, same instructions, same small model, thinking off.
10 of 10 valid on the first try, 23 of 30 claims found
Pydantic checks every reply, and none needed a retry
Ollama only lets the model write text that fits the schema
in 4 papers the model wrote plain text, and LangChain returned None with no error
